name: Open Days
source:
Kyouhei is your ordinary protagonist in an ordinary school with extraordinarily hot classmates and of course, a hot teacher. And since the school is boring, what else is there to do than have dirty thoughts and try your luck? Seriously a hentai parody. 

[From [URL=http://renai.us/game/opendays.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/URL]]
